name: malayalam-arc-c-2.5k
description: Malayalam-arc-c-2.5k is a Malayalam-language version of the ARC (AI2 Reasoning Challenge) Challenge set containing approximately 2.5k science multiple-choice questions. It measures a model's ability to answer grade-school to middle-school level science questions translated into Malayalam, stressing multilingual and domain-specific reasoning in a low-resource language. The set is intended to evaluate knowledge retrieval and reasoning under language transfer constraints rather than open-ended generation.
reputation: Part of the Indic-Benchmark suite; commonly used to evaluate multilingual and low-resource QA performance for Indic languages.
